entries.text: I like to go hiking in the mountains.
entries.translation: 我喜欢去山里徒步旅行。

translations.zh-Hans: 我喜欢去山里徒步旅行。

entries.text: On weekends, I usually visit my family.
entries.translation: 周末，我通常会去看望家人。

translations.zh-Hans: 周末，我通常会去看望家人。

entries.text: I often meet friends for coffee on Saturdays.
entries.translation: 我经常在周六和朋友喝咖啡。

translations.zh-Hans: 我经常在周六和朋友喝咖啡。

entries.text: I spend my Sundays cooking new recipes.
entries.translation: 我把周日用来尝试新食谱。

translations.zh-Hans: 我把周日用来尝试新食谱。

entries.text: Sometimes I just stay home and relax with a good book.
entries.translation: 有时我只是待在家里，拿本好书放松一下。

translations.zh-Hans: 有时我只是待在家里，拿本好书放松一下。

entries.text: I prefer to spend my time at home watching movies.
Going for a walk in the park is a nice way to spend the day.
entries.translation: 去公园散步是度过一天的好方法。

translations.zh-Hans: 去公园散步是度过一天的好方法。

entries.text: On weekends, I like to either visit a museum or just chill at home.
entries.translation: 周末，我喜欢去博物馆或在家放松。

translations.zh-Hans: 周末，我喜欢去博物馆或在家放松。

entries.text: I like to spend time with my family on weekends, maybe have a barbecue.
entries.translation: 我喜欢周末和家人共度时光，也许会来个烧烤。

translations.zh-Hans: 我喜欢周末和家人共度时光，也许会来个烧烤。

entries.text: My ideal weekend involves hiking with friends and enjoying nature.
entries.translation: 我理想的周末是和朋友一起去徒步旅行，享受大自然。

translations.zh-Hans: 我理想的周末是和朋友一起去徒步旅行，享受大自然。

entries.text: Sometimes, I just want to stay home and watch TV all day.
entries.translation: 有时候，我只想待在家里看一整天电视。

translations.zh-Hans: 有时候，我只想待在家里看一整天电视。

entries.text: Spending time with my family on Sundays is very important to me.
entries.translation: 周日和家人共度时光对我来说非常重要。

translations.zh-Hans: 周日和家人共度时光对我来说非常重要。

entries.text: My ideal weekend involves spending time in nature, maybe hiking or having a picnic.
entries.translation: 我理想的周末是花时间在大自然中，也许是徒步旅行或野餐。

translations.zh-Hans: 我理想的周末是花时间在大自然中，也许是徒步旅行或野餐。

entries.text: When I'm alone, I like to watch movies or catch up on my favorite TV shows.
entries.translation: 当我独处时，我喜欢看电影或追我最喜欢的电视剧。

translations.zh-Hans: 当我独处时，我喜欢看电影或追我最喜欢的电视剧。

entries.text: A perfect weekend for me is one where I can spend quality time with family and friends.
entries.translation: 对我来说，完美的周末是能和家人朋友共度美好时光。

translations.zh-Hans: 对我来说，完美的周末是能和家人朋友共度美好时光。

entries.text: I find weekends most enjoyable when I can balance some social time with relaxation.
entries.translation: 我觉得周末最愉快的是能在社交和放松之间找到平衡。

translations.zh-Hans: 我觉得周末最愉快的是能在社交和放松之间找到平衡。
